purpose: Independent art-direction review of the new mouth reference against v18; approximate image measurements, not calibrated 3D reconstruction
reference: User-provided three-view mouth reference sheet (original image not redistributed)
central_finding: v18 expands a horizontal ellipse inside an almost fixed circular skull. The reference drops the entire lower jaw/chin, while keeping the upper skull and upper lip relatively stable, producing a tall U-shaped aperture and a much taller open-head silhouette.

mouth_contour.upper: Flatter central arch with a mild center rise, rounded corners, and a thick rounded textile edge; do not use the upper half of a regular ellipse.
mouth_contour.lower: Deep U shape / rounded trapezoid, slightly narrower at the bottom. The outer chin must travel downward along with the inner aperture.
mouth_contour.closed: Single continuous upturned smile seam: center slightly lower than corners. No enamel flecks or internal cavity should show.
mouth_contour.side: C-shaped silhouette with a visible upper muzzle lip overhang and a lower fabric jaw rim rotated/dropped forward/down. Preserve substantial cranium volume behind the cavity.
mouth_contour.interior: Deep concave charcoal-purple velvet lining, visible side walls and lower floor/fold; not a featureless black plane and not wet red gums. Teeth roots are partly buried behind lining and cloth rim.

teeth: Two dominant upper canines near the outer thirds; approximately twice the length of central teeth, thicker roots and curved inward tips.
Central upper teeth shorter and uneven; avoid a symmetric row of nearly identical cones.
Lower teeth follow a curved U in three dimensions, not a straight horizontal picket fence. Larger lower fangs are offset from the center.
Use enamel gradient, subtle longitudinal grooves and round roots, with sharp but not needle-thin tips.
Retraction in the closed pose must hide every tooth behind the closed fabric surface.
secondary_shape_corrections: Upright ear should be much wider and pillow-like, with a rounded top rather than a narrow plank.
Bent ear needs a broad drooping distal lobe and a dark warm inner felt surface; v18 currently has a small angular hooked tip.
The tan ear seam consists of a longitudinal thread plus transverse stitches; in v18 side view threads visibly float away from the ear and must be projected/weighted to its surface.
Eyes are flush luminous fabric apertures, not visibly protruding tablets. Existing diameter is near target; slightly closer spacing and soft warm bloom help.
Head should sit into broad shoulders; avoid the current visible cylindrical neck and separated capsule-like shoulders in portrait view.
Shift royal-blue fleece toward dark blue-violet. Replace uniform fine roughness with visible clustered curl/boucle breakup while keeping lip displacement restrained.
recommended_numeric_checks: Sample MouthOpen at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 and 1; measure aperture height/width and outer chin displacement separately.
Compare left/right lip-loop vertices across X reflection before applying intentional tooth variation.
Track the upper lip and eye displacement while jaw opens; they should not rise substantially with the lower jaw.
Probe self-intersections and upper/lower tooth collisions in every sampled mouth state, not only the neutral saved pose.
At MouthOpen=0, raycast from several frontal directions to ensure no visible teeth or mouth interior escape the closed seam.
Render matched head closeups: closed front, half-open front, wide-open front and wide-open profile. Full-body thumbnails are too small for this correction.
